name: BRCA Multiomics Relapse Benchmark
description: Benchmarking multi-omics (RNA-seq + 450k methylation) predictive models for breast cancer relapse against a clinical baseline in TCGA-BRCA, with METABRIC external validation. Nested CV with leakage control, SHAP signatures, a pathway-informed neural net, and a multi-modal autoencoder. Reproducible via Docker + Nextflow.
